headline: Keep an eye on your EBox usage
intro: EBox connects Home Assistant to the My Usage page for your EBox account. Configure the sensor platform with your account credentials and choose which usage values to track; the integration polls the cloud service.
highlights: Select monitored values such as usage percentage, balance in CAD, data limit, or days left
Track download, upload, and total data, including separate off-peak and before-off-peak readings
Sensor data is refreshed no more often than every 15 minutes
